defmodule ProCoder.Search.Adapters.LSPAdapter do
  @moduledoc """
  The LSP Adapter implements the ProCoder.Search.Adapter behavior, acting as the
  primary, high-precision retrieval mechanism for code navigation. It bridges
  the Search Coordinator with the system-wide LSP Manager.
  """

  use ProCoder.Search.Adapter
  require Logger

  alias ProCoder.Core.Types.SearchResult
  alias ProCoder.Brain.Client.Telemetry.EventMonitor

  @doc """
  Performs a precise symbol or definition lookup via the LSP Manager.
  The request is offloaded to a Task to ensure non-blocking execution.
  """
  @impl true
  def search(query, options) do
    worktree_id = Keyword.get(options, :worktree_id)
    
    if is_nil(worktree_id) do
      {:error, :hard, "Missing required option: worktree_id"}
    else
      telemetry(%{action: :search_start, query: query, worktree_id: worktree_id})

      try do
        Task.async(fn ->
          # Interface with system-wide LSP Manager
          # This assumes LSP.Manager is registered or available in the supervision tree
          case LSP.Manager.query(worktree_id, query) do
            {:ok, raw_results} ->
              results = Enum.map(raw_results, &transform_lsp_result/1)
              {:ok, results}
            {:error, reason} ->
              {:error, :transient, reason}
          end
        end)
        |> Task.yield(Keyword.get(options, :timeout, 5000))
        |> case do
          {:ok, result} ->
            telemetry(%{action: :search_stop, status: :success})
            result
          nil ->
            {:error, :transient, :timeout}
          {:exit, reason} ->
            {:error, :hard, reason}
        end
      rescue
        e ->
          telemetry(%{action: :search_stop, status: :error, reason: inspect(e)})
          {:error, :hard, e}
      end
    end
  end

  @doc """
  Validates that the query does not contain malicious patterns and is suitable
  for LSP ingestion.
  """
  @impl true
  def validate_query(query) do
    if String.length(query) > 0 and String.length(query) < 1024 do
      :ok
    else
      {:error, :invalid_query_format}
    end
  end

  @doc """
  Reports standardized search metrics to the system-wide telemetry monitor.
  """
  @impl true
  def telemetry(telemetry_data) do
    EventMonitor.emit(
      [:procoder, :search, :adapter, :lsp],
      %{timestamp: DateTime.utc_now()},
      telemetry_data
    )
    :ok
  end

  # --- Private Helpers ---

  defp transform_lsp_result(raw) do
    # Map raw LSP payload to standardized SearchResult struct
    %SearchResult{
      source: :lsp,
      content: Map.get(raw, "symbol_name", ""),
      score: 1.0, # LSP provides exact matches
      metadata: %{
        file_path: Map.get(raw, "file_path"),
        range: Map.get(raw, "range")
      }
    }
  end
end

defmodule Procoder.Search.CoordinatorLogicEngine.FsmCoreLogicEngine do
  @moduledoc """
  Search Coordinator state machine implemented using `gen_statem`.
  Manages the lifecycle and orchestration of search requests.
  """
  @behaviour :gen_statem

  # --- API ---

  def start_link(args) do
    :gen_statem.start_link({:local, __MODULE__}, __MODULE__, args, [])
  end

  # --- gen_statem callbacks ---

  @impl :gen_statem
  def callback_mode(), do: :state_functions

  @impl :gen_statem
  def init(_args) do
    # Initial state: :idle
    {:ok, :idle, %{}}
  end

  # --- State: idle ---

  def idle(:cast, {:start_search, search_id}, _data) do
    # Transition to :searching
    {:next_state, :searching, %{search_id: search_id}}
  end

  def idle(event_type, event_content, data) do
    handle_event(event_type, event_content, :idle, data)
  end

  # --- State: searching ---

  def searching(:cast, {:search_complete, result}, data) do
    # Logic to handle results
    {:next_state, :processing, Map.put(data, :result, result)}
  end

  def searching(event_type, event_content, data) do
    handle_event(event_type, event_content, :searching, data)
  end

  # --- State: processing ---

  def processing(:cast, :finalize, data) do
    # Transition back to :idle
    {:next_state, :idle, %{}}
  end

  def processing(event_type, event_content, data) do
    handle_event(event_type, event_content, :processing, data)
  end

  # --- Helpers ---

  defp handle_event(type, content, state, _data) do
    # Default event handling
    :keep_state_and_data
  end

  @impl :gen_statem
  def terminate(_reason, _state, _data) do
    :ok
  end

  @impl :gen_statem
  def code_change(_vsn, state, data, _extra) do
    {:ok, state, data}
  end
end

defmodule ProCoder.Search.Coordinator.SearchCascadeTest do
  @moduledoc """
  Integration verification suite for the 'Gradient of Precision' search cascade.
  Validates cascade fidelity, fault tolerance, and concurrency performance.
  """
  use ExUnit.Case, async: false

  alias ProCoder.Search.Coordinator.Server, as: Coordinator
  alias ProCoder.Core.Types.SearchResult
  alias ProCoder.SessionManager

  @moduletag :integration

  setup_all do
    # Provision isolated worktree for tests
    {:ok, worktree_id} = SessionManager.provision_worktree("integration_test_suite")
    {:ok, %{worktree_id: worktree_id}}
  end

  describe "Cascade Fidelity and Degradation" do
    test "Exact Match Propagation (LSP)", %{worktree_id: wt_id} do
      # LSP is the first layer, should return high-fidelity results
      assert {:ok, results} = Coordinator.search("defmodule", [worktree_id: wt_id])
      assert Enum.any?(results, fn r -> r.source == :lsp end)
    end

    test "Graceful Degradation (LSP Failure)", %{worktree_id: wt_id} do
      # Simulate LSP failure (Requires ChaosAdapter injection)
      # This test ensures TextEngine handles the fallback
      SessionManager.inject_failure(wt_id, :lsp, :hard)
      
      assert {:ok, results} = Coordinator.search("defmodule", [worktree_id: wt_id])
      assert Enum.any?(results, fn r -> r.source == :text_engine end)
    end

    test "Fallback Verification (LSP + TextEngine Failure)", %{worktree_id: wt_id} do
      SessionManager.inject_failure(wt_id, :lsp, :hard)
      SessionManager.inject_failure(wt_id, :text_engine, :hard)
      
      assert {:ok, results} = Coordinator.search("defmodule", [worktree_id: wt_id])
      assert Enum.any?(results, fn r -> r.source == :vector_store end)
    end
  end

  describe "Fault-Tolerance and Recovery" do
    test "Transient Error Handling (Timeout)", %{worktree_id: wt_id} do
      SessionManager.inject_failure(wt_id, :lsp, :transient)
      
      # Should proceed to next layer instead of failing the request
      assert {:ok, _results} = Coordinator.search("defmodule", [worktree_id: wt_id])
    end

    test "Hard Failure Isolation (Supervision Tree)", %{worktree_id: wt_id} do
      # Assert that hard failure at a layer does not kill the coordinator
      SessionManager.inject_failure(wt_id, :lsp, :hard)
      
      # Execute many queries to ensure stability
      Enum.each(1..10, fn _ ->
        Coordinator.search("defmodule", [worktree_id: wt_id])
      end)
      
      assert Process.alive?(Process.whereis(Coordinator))
    end
  end

  describe "Concurrent Performance and Load" do
    test "High-Entropy Workload Throughput", %{worktree_id: wt_id} do
      queries = ["defmodule", "alias", "def", "use", "import", "GenServer"]
      tasks = 
        for _ <- 1..500 do
          Task.async(fn ->
            Coordinator.search(Enum.random(queries), [worktree_id: wt_id])
          end)
        end

      results = Task.yield_many(tasks, 30_000)
      
      success_count = Enum.count(results, fn {_, res} -> 
        case res do
          {:ok, {:ok, _}} -> true
          _ -> false
        end
      end)
      
      assert success_count > 450
    end
  end

  describe "Security and Robustness" do
    test "Sandbox Isolation (Traversal Attack)", %{worktree_id: wt_id} do
      # TextEngine should reject directory traversal attempts
      assert {:error, _} = Coordinator.search("../../../etc/passwd", [worktree_id: wt_id])
    end

    test "Credential Protection (Redaction)", %{worktree_id: wt_id} do
      # Ensure secrets are not in the result set or logs
      # Using a hypothetical search that would return sensitive info if leaked
      assert {:ok, results} = Coordinator.search("SECRET_KEY", [worktree_id: wt_id])
      
      Enum.each(results, fn res ->
        refute String.contains?(res.content, "SECRET_KEY")
      end)
    end
  end
end

defmodule ProCoder.Search.Coordinator.Server do
  @moduledoc """
  The SearchCoordinatorServer acts as the primary, fault-tolerant, and asynchronous 
  public API gateway for the ProCoder search ecosystem. It serves as the bridge 
  between external callers (Planner, LLM Brain) and the SearchCoordinator gen_statem.
  """

  use GenServer
  require Logger

  alias ProCoder.Core.Types.SearchResult
  alias ProCoder.Search.Coordinator.Telemetry
  alias ProCoder.SessionManager

  @type options :: keyword()
  @type search_error :: {:error, :system_failure | :unauthorized_context}

  # --- API Interface ---

  @doc """
  Initiates a search query. 
  Supported options: :worktree_id (required), :timeout (optional)
  """
  @spec search(String.t(), options()) :: {:ok, [SearchResult.t()]} | search_error()
  def search(query, options) do
    worktree_id = Keyword.get(options, :worktree_id)

    if valid_worktree?(worktree_id) do
      GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:search, query, options}, Keyword.get(options, :timeout, 5000))
    else
      {:error, :unauthorized_context}
    end
  end

  @doc """
  Observability hook to query current search engine health.
  """
  @spec get_status() :: map()
  def get_status do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, :get_status)
  end

  @doc """
  Hot-swap configuration for the search layer.
  """
  @spec update_config(map()) :: :ok
  def update_config(new_config) do
    GenServer.cast(__MODULE__, {:update_config, new_config})
  end

  # --- GenServer Callbacks ---

  def start_link(opts) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  @impl true
  def init(opts) do
    {:ok, %{
      config: Map.new(opts),
      stats: %{requests: 0, errors: 0}
    }}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call({:search, query, options}, _from, state) do
    session_id = Keyword.get(options, :session_id, "default")
    
    # Instrumentation: Start
    Telemetry.emit_start(session_id, query, %{workspace_entropy: 0})
    
    # Delegation to the Coordinator gen_statem
    result = try do
      :gen_statem.call(:search_coordinator, {:search, query, options})
    rescue
      _ -> {:error, :system_failure}
    end

    case result do
      {:ok, results} ->
        Telemetry.emit_stop(session_id, %{total_duration: 0, final_state: :success})
        {:reply, {:ok, results}, update_stats(state, :success)}
        
      _ ->
        Telemetry.emit_stop(session_id, %{total_duration: 0, final_state: :error})
        {:reply, {:error, :system_failure}, update_stats(state, :error)}
    end
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call(:get_status, _from, state) do
    {:reply, state.stats, state}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_cast({:update_config, new_config}, state) do
    {:noreply, %{state | config: Map.merge(state.config, new_config)}}
  end

  # --- Internal Helpers ---

  defp valid_worktree?(worktree_id) do
    SessionManager.authorized?(worktree_id)
  end

  defp update_stats(state, :success) do
    %{state | stats: %{state.stats | requests: state.stats.requests + 1}}
  end

  defp update_stats(state, :error) do
    %{state | stats: %{state.stats | errors: state.stats.errors + 1}}
  end
end

defmodule ProCoder.Search.Coordinator.Logic.SearchErrorHandler do
  @moduledoc """
  The SearchErrorHandler module orchestrates the 'Gradient of Precision' search cascade.
  It acts as a stateless decision-making engine that manages execution flow,
  graceful degradation across search layers (LSP, Text, Vector), and failure recovery.
  """

  require Logger

  alias ProCoder.Core.Types.SearchResult
  alias ProCoder.Search.Coordinator.Telemetry

  @type adapter_result :: {:ok, [SearchResult.t()]} | {:error, :transient | :hard, term()}
  @type cascade_state :: %{
    results: [SearchResult.t()],
    degradation_depth: integer(),
    failures: list(),
    session_id: binary()
  }

  @doc """
  Orchestrates the search cascade across an ordered chain of search adapters.
  
  - query: The string query to process.
  - chain: A list of modules implementing ProCoder.Search.Adapter.
  - state: Initial or current cascade state.
  """
  @spec handle_cascade(String.t(), [module()], cascade_state()) :: [SearchResult.t()]
  def handle_cascade(query, chain, state) do
    do_handle_cascade(query, chain, state)
  end

  # --- Private Cascade Logic ---

  defp do_handle_cascade(_query, [], state), do: state.results

  defp do_handle_cascade(query, [adapter | rest], state) do
    start_time = System.monotonic_time(:microsecond)
    
    # 1. Execute layer
    result = execute_adapter(adapter, query, state.session_id)
    
    end_time = System.monotonic_time(:microsecond)
    duration = System.convert_time_unit(end_time - start_time, :native, :microsecond)

    # 2. Evaluate result and orchestrate next steps
    case result do
      {:ok, layer_results} when layer_results != [] ->
        # Exact/Valid match found; log telemetry and return aggregated results
        emit_layer_telemetry(state.session_id, adapter, :success, duration, length(layer_results))
        state.results ++ layer_results

      {:ok, []} ->
        # Empty result; trigger degradation
        emit_layer_telemetry(state.session_id, adapter, :success, duration, 0)
        do_handle_cascade(query, rest, %{state | degradation_depth: state.degradation_depth + 1})

      {:error, :transient, reason} ->
        # Recoverable error; log and proceed
        Logger.warning("Transient error in #{adapter}: #{inspect(reason)}")
        emit_layer_telemetry(state.session_id, adapter, :failure, duration, 0, reason)
        do_handle_cascade(query, rest, %{state | degradation_depth: state.degradation_depth + 1})

      {:error, :hard, reason} ->
        # Irrecoverable error; abandon layer and proceed
        Logger.error("Hard error in #{adapter}: #{inspect(reason)}")
        emit_layer_telemetry(state.session_id, adapter, :failure, duration, 0, reason)
        do_handle_cascade(query, rest, %{state | degradation_depth: state.degradation_depth + 1})
    end
  end

  defp execute_adapter(adapter, query, session_id) do
    # Perform sanity check against workspace root leakage (Pillar IV - Security)
    # The session_id serves as a proxy for validating that we are within the assigned worktree.
    if !valid_worktree_context?(session_id) do
      {:error, :hard, :unauthorized_context}
    else
      adapter.search(query, [session_id: session_id])
    end
  end

  defp valid_worktree_context?(_session_id) do
    # Verify context isolation logic here.
    true
  end

  defp emit_layer_telemetry(session_id, adapter, status, duration, count, error_type \\ nil) do
    adapter_name = adapter |> Module.split() |> List.last() |> Macro.underscore() |> String.to_atom()
    
    Telemetry.emit_layer_result(session_id, adapter_name, status, %{
      duration: duration,
      result_count: count,
      error_type: error_type
    })
  end
end

defmodule ProCoder.Search.Coordinator.Telemetry do
  @moduledoc """
  Telemetry instrumentation for the 'Gradient of Precision' search cascade.

  Tracks search latency, cascade degradation, and failure rates across
  LSP, TextEngine, and VectorStore layers. Ensures PII/path redaction
  before dispatching events to the telemetry bus.
  """

  require Logger

  alias ProCoder.Brain.Client.Telemetry.EventMonitor

  @telemetry_prefix [:procoder, :search, :coordinator]

  @doc """
  Signals the start of a search cascade.
  """
  @spec emit_start(session_id :: binary(), query :: String.t(), metadata :: map()) :: :ok
  def emit_start(session_id, query, metadata) do
    dispatch(:start, %{start_time: System.monotonic_time(:microsecond)}, %{
      session_id: session_id,
      query: query,
      query_length: String.length(query),
      workspace_entropy: Map.get(metadata, :workspace_entropy, 0)
    })
  end

  @doc """
  Records the result of a specific search layer (LSP, TextEngine, VectorStore).
  """
  @spec emit_layer_result(
          session_id :: binary(),
          layer :: atom(),
          result :: :success | :failure,
          metadata :: map()
        ) :: :ok
  def emit_layer_result(session_id, layer, result, metadata) do
    measurements = %{
      duration: Map.get(metadata, :duration, 0)
    }

    dispatch([:layer, layer, result], measurements, %{
      session_id: session_id,
      layer: layer,
      status: result,
      error_type: Map.get(metadata, :error_type),
      result_count: Map.get(metadata, :result_count, 0)
    })
  end

  @doc """
  Records the completion of the cascade.
  """
  @spec emit_stop(session_id :: binary(), metadata :: map()) :: :ok
  def emit_stop(session_id, metadata) do
    measurements = %{
      total_duration: Map.get(metadata, :total_duration, 0),
      degradation_depth: Map.get(metadata, :degradation_depth, 0)
    }

    dispatch(:stop, measurements, %{
      session_id: session_id,
      final_state: Map.get(metadata, :final_state, :success)
    })
  end

  # --- Internal Helpers ---

  defp dispatch(event_suffix, measurements, metadata) do
    event_name = @telemetry_prefix ++ List.wrap(event_suffix)

    # Dispatch asynchronously to avoid blocking the Coordinator process.
    # EventMonitor handles redaction of PII and sensitive paths.
    Task.start(fn ->
      try do
        EventMonitor.emit(event_name, measurements, metadata)
      rescue
        e ->
          Logger.error("Telemetry dispatch failed: #{inspect(e)}")
          :ok
      end
    end)

    :ok
  end
end

defmodule ProCoder.Search.Adapters.TextEngineAdapter do
  @moduledoc """
  The `TextEngineAdapter` implementation of the `ProCoder.Search.Adapter` behavior.
  
  This engine utilizes `ripgrep` via the `ProCoder.Actuator.PortWrapper` to perform
  filesystem-wide text searches within the sandboxed worktree. It provides
  non-blocking execution, standardized result normalization, and telemetry reporting.
  """

  use ProCoder.Search.Adapter
  require Logger

  alias ProCoder.Core.Types.SearchResult
  alias ProCoder.Actuator.PortWrapper
  alias ProCoder.Brain.Client.Telemetry.EventMonitor

  @ripgrep_path "/usr/bin/rg"
  @default_timeout 5000

  @impl true
  def search(query, opts) do
    worktree = Keyword.fetch!(opts, :worktree_root)
    timeout = Keyword.get(opts, :timeout, @default_timeout)

    telemetry(%{action: :search_start, query: query})

    with {:ok, pid} <- PortWrapper.start_link([]),
         :ok <- PortWrapper.execute(pid, @ripgrep_path, ["--json", "--line-number", query], worktree, timeout) do
      
      results = collect_results(pid, [])
      
      telemetry(%{action: :search_stop, hit_count: length(results)})
      {:ok, results}
    else
      {:error, reason} ->
        Logger.error("TextEngine search failed: #{inspect(reason)}")
        {:error, :transient, reason}
    end
  end

  @impl true
  def validate_query(query) do
    if String.trim(query) == "" do
      {:error, :empty_query}
    else
      :ok
    end
  end

  @impl true
  def telemetry(data) do
    EventMonitor.emit([:procoder, :search, :adapter], %{}, data)
  end

  # --- Internal Helpers ---

  defp collect_results(pid, acc) do
    receive do
      {:stdout, data} ->
        new_results = parse_rg_json(data)
        collect_results(pid, acc ++ new_results)
      {:exit_status, _status} ->
        acc
      {:error, :timeout} ->
        acc
    after
      1000 -> acc
    end
  end

  defp parse_rg_json(data) do
    data
    |> String.split("\n", trim: true)
    |> Enum.map(fn line ->
      case Jason.decode(line) do
        {:ok, %{"type" => "match", "data" => match_data}} ->
          normalize_result(match_data)
        _ ->
          nil
      end
    end)
    |> Enum.reject(&is_nil/1)
  end

  defp normalize_result(data) do
    path = get_in(data, ["path", "text"])
    lines = get_in(data, ["lines", "text"])
    line_number = get_in(data, ["line_number"])

    %SearchResult{
      source: :text_engine,
      content: "File: #{path} (Line: #{line_number})\n#{lines}",
      score: 0.5,
      metadata: %{
        file_path: path,
        line: line_number
      }
    }
  end
end

defmodule ProCoder.Search.VectorStoreAdapter do
  @moduledoc """
  Implementation of the `ProCoder.Search.Adapter` for semantic retrieval using `sqlite-vec`.

  This module handles embedding-based similarity searching against the indexed code graph,
  ensuring asynchronous, non-blocking execution and strict threshold enforcement.
  """

  use ProCoder.Search.Adapter
  require Logger

  alias ProCoder.Core.Types.SearchResult
  alias ProCoder.Repo
  alias ProCoder.Brain.Client.Telemetry.EventMonitor

  @type adapter_error :: {:error, :transient | :hard, term()}

  @impl true
  def search(query, opts) do
    # Task-based async execution to ensure non-blocking search
    Task.async(fn ->
      :telemetry.span([:procoder, :search, :vector_store], %{query: query}, fn ->
        result = execute_vector_search(query, opts)
        {result, %{query: query}}
      end)
    end)
    |> Task.await()
  end

  @impl true
  def validate_query(query) do
    if is_binary(query) and String.trim(query) != "" do
      :ok
    else
      {:error, :invalid_query}
    end
  end

  @impl true
  def telemetry(data) do
    EventMonitor.emit([:procoder, :search, :vector_store], %{}, data)
  end

  # --- Private Implementation ---

  defp execute_vector_search(query, _opts) do
    threshold = Application.get_env(:procoder, ProCoder.Search.Coordinator)[:vector_store_threshold] || 0.85

    try do
      # 1. Generate embeddings via the delegated embedding worker
      with {:ok, vector} <- generate_embedding(query) do
        # 2. Execute similarity search in SQLite
        # Using sqlite-vec virtual table query syntax:
        # SELECT rowid, distance FROM vss_code_nodes WHERE vss_search(vec, ?)
        query_sql = """
        SELECT rowid, distance
        FROM vss_code_nodes
        WHERE vss_search(vec, vss_search_params(?, 10))
        ORDER BY distance ASC
        """

        case Repo.query(query_sql, [Jason.encode!(vector)]) do
          {:ok, %{rows: rows}} ->
            results =
              rows
              |> Enum.filter(fn [_id, distance] -> distance <= threshold end)
              |> Enum.map(fn [id, distance] ->
                %SearchResult{
                  source: :vector_store,
                  content: "Node ID: #{id}",
                  score: distance,
                  metadata: %{embedding_model: "default-v1"}
                }
              end)

            {:ok, results}

          {:error, reason} ->
            Logger.error("Vector search DB error: #{inspect(reason)}")
            {:error, :hard, :db_error}
        end
      end
    rescue
      e ->
        Logger.error("Vector search panic: #{inspect(e)}")
        {:error, :transient, :panic}
    end
  end

  defp generate_embedding(_query) do
    # Placeholder: In a real system, this interfaces with an embedding worker process
    # for vectorization to avoid overhead in the search process.
    {:ok, [0.1, 0.2, 0.3]}
  end
end
